snippet.title: Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road | Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Announced during the ID@Xbox Fall 2025 Showcase, Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road will launch on November 20th 2025, day one on  Xbox Game Pass, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, Steam, and GOG. It will also support Xbox Play Anywhere, be Xbox Handheld / Steam Deck Verified at launch, and release on Xbox Series X|S at a later date. 

A demo is available to play on Steam right now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3814210/Monsters_are_Coming_Rock__Road_Demo/

WISHLIST ON STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2934220/Monsters_are_Coming_Rock__Road/

WISHLIST ON XBOX - https://www.xbox.com/games/store/monsters-are-coming-rock-road/9pjbkf27c16m

WISHLIST ON GOG - https://www.gog.com/en/game/monsters_are_coming_rock_road

Beware, Monsters are Coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Ark?  

Fortify: Create your own builds to maximise efficiency by choosing, placing, and upgrading districts through continued run progression. Equip defensive structures to repel monsters from the gates, and keep the city moving forward, else the darkness will consume you!

Forage: Gather wood, stone and gold as a persistent hero who must constantly balance risk vs reward while fighting back endless armies of monsters. Stray from the beaten path to find richer rewards or keep heading due south towards the safety of shelter. 

Fight: Beat Bad Ass Bosses, improve your abilities, overcome environmental obstacles and take charge of special weaponry to continually adapt your strategies. Or see your city turned to ash!

You’re the last hope for humanity, but it’s a long road to the Ark.
